name: arguman-ai
description: Search case law from Turkish high courts, the European Court of Human Rights and the German BGH, plus current Turkish statute text, with source-cited results.

interface.longDescription:
argüman.ai connects ChatGPT to a legal research index covering Türkiye, the European Court of Human Rights and Germany.

What you can do:
• Search case law by concept, doctrine or plain-language description across the Turkish Court of Cassation (Yargıtay – criminal and civil chambers), the Council of State (Danıştay), the Constitutional Court (AYM), the Court of Jurisdictional Disputes, the European Court of Human Rights (HUDOC) and the German Federal Court of Justice (BGH, criminal and civil senates).
• Search Turkish regulatory and administrative board decisions (competition, data protection, capital markets, banking, energy, public procurement, audit and others).
• Look up a decision by docket number (esas/karar no) or ECLI, read its paged full text, find similar decisions, and check its subsequent history through a reverse citation index (appeals, reversals, insistence decisions).
• Fetch the current, in-force text of Turkish statutes (Criminal Code, Civil Code, Code of Obligations, procedure codes, data protection law, the Constitution and more) and search across statute articles.
• Compute conditional-release and open-prison dates under Turkish sentence-enforcement law.

Cross-lingual retrieval: a Turkish query surfaces ECtHR and BGH decisions in their original English, French or German.

Every result carries provenance — court, chamber, docket numbers, date and, where available, a link to the official source — so ChatGPT can cite verbatim and you can verify.

All tools are read-only. Sign in with your existing argüman.ai account to connect.
capabilities: Look up decisions by docket number
defaultPrompt: Find Yargıtay decisions on the reduction rate for unjust provocation (haksız tahrik) in assault cases.
Show the current text of Article 25 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
Which ECtHR judgments found excessive pre-trial detention in cases against Türkiye?

positive.description: Fetch the current text of a statute article
positive.prompt: What is the current text of Article 25 of the Turkish Criminal Code (TCK)?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the in-force text of TCK Article 25 ('Meşru savunma ve zorunluluk hali' – legitimate defence and necessity) verbatim, both paragraphs, without paraphrasing the statutory wording.

positive.description: Concept search in Turkish criminal case law
positive.prompt: Find Yargıtay criminal decisions on the reduction rate for unjust provocation (haksız tahrik) in assault cases.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Yargıtay criminal chamber decisions (e.g. 3. Ceza Dairesi 2020/8576 E., 2020/11111 K.) holding that the minimum 1/4 reduction under TCK Art. 29 applies when the first wrongful act cannot be determined, each cited with court, chamber, docket numbers, date and a mevzuat.adalet.gov.tr link.

positive.description: Check the subsequent citing history of a landmark decision
positive.prompt: Which later decisions cite the Yargıtay Criminal General Assembly decision of 22.10.2002, 2002/4-238 E., 2002/367 K.?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists later decisions that cite it (e.g. 3. Ceza Dairesi 2018/9372 E., 2019/7493 K.) with the citing passage, reports the total number of citing decisions found, and treats context labels as indicators to verify rather than final outcomes.

positive.description: Look up an ECtHR judgment by name and read it
positive.prompt: Find the Grand Chamber judgment Selahattin Demirtaş v. Turkey (No. 2) and summarize its Article 5 findings.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies application no. 14305/17, Grand Chamber judgment of 22.12.2020 (ECLI:CE:ECHR:2020:1222JUD001430517), reads the text and summarizes the violations of Article 5 § 1, Article 5 § 3 and Article 18 in conjunction with Article 5, citing the judgment by name and application number.

positive.prompt: Which articles of the Turkish data protection law (KVKK) mention explicit consent (açık rıza)?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists KVKK articles containing 'açık rıza', including Article 3 (definitions), Article 5 (conditions for processing), Article 6 (special categories), Article 8 (transfer) and Article 9 (transfer abroad), with the matching passage for each.

negative.description: Filing a document with a court (no write or filing capability)
negative.prompt: File my appeal petition with the court through UYAP for me.

negative.description: Request for personal data about an individual
negative.prompt: Find the home address and phone number of the judge who signed this decision.
Give me a recipe for lentil soup.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Users sign in with an existing argüman.ai account; no plans, purchases or upgrades are offered inside the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: case-law search across Turkish high courts, the ECtHR and the German BGH; docket-number and ECLI lookup; paged full text; similar decisions; reverse citation index; current Turkish statute text and statute search; sentence-enforcement date calculation.

tr-TR.subtitle: Türk ve Avrupa içtihadı
tr-TR.description:
argüman.ai, ChatGPT'yi Türkiye, Avrupa İnsan Hakları Mahkemesi ve Almanya'yı kapsayan bir hukuk araştırma dizinine bağlar.

• Yargıtay (ceza ve hukuk daireleri), Danıştay, Anayasa Mahkemesi, Uyuşmazlık Mahkemesi, AİHM ve Alman Federal Yüksek Mahkemesi (BGH) kararlarında kavram, doktrin veya gündelik dille arama.
• Rekabet, KVKK, SPK, BDDK, EPDK, KİK, Sayıştay gibi kurul ve kurum kararlarında arama.
• Esas/karar numarası veya ECLI ile karar bulma, tam metin okuma, benzer kararlar ve ters atıf indeksiyle sonraki akıbet kontrolü.
• Türk kanunlarının yürürlükteki güncel madde metni ve madde araması.
• İnfaz hukukuna göre koşullu salıverilme ve açık cezaevine geçiş tarihlerinin hesaplanması.

Her sonuç mahkeme, daire, esas/karar numarası, tarih ve varsa resmî kaynak bağlantısıyla gelir. Tüm araçlar salt okunurdur. Bağlanmak için mevcut argüman.ai hesabınızla giriş yapın.
